description: Configure automated staff activity checks and response logging.

content.name: enableActivityChecks
content.description: Allows admins to start an activity check to see who is active, and also set automatic activity checks.

content.name: targetRoles
content.description: The roles required to respond to the activity check. Anyone with these roles will be expected to click the button. Leave empty to default to the General Staff Roles.

content.name: timeframe
content.description: How long staff have to respond to the activity check (Max 168 hours / 1 week).

content.name: checkMessage
content.description: The message sent when an activity check starts.

params.name: end-time
params.description: The Discord timestamp when the check ends.

params.name: staff-mention
params.description: Mention of the configured staff role(s).

params.name: supervisor-mention
params.description: Mention of the configured supervisor role(s).

params.name: management-mention
params.description: Mention of the configured management role(s).

params.name: initiator
params.description: The user who iniated the activity check. This will show 'system' if it was an automated check.

embeds.title: 📋 Staff Activity Check
embeds.description: Please confirm your activity by clicking the button below before %end-time%. This activity check will stay open for %duration% hour(s), and members who do not respond before it ends may be marked as failed unless they qualify for an exception.

content.name: endCheckMessage
content.description: The message that will replace the activity check embed when it ends.

params.name: end-time
params.description: The Discord timestamp when the check ended.

params.name: staff-mention
params.description: Mention of the configured staff role(s).

params.name: supervisor-mention
params.description: Mention of the configured supervisor role(s).

params.name: management-mention
params.description: Mention of the configured management role(s).

params.name: initiator
params.description: The user who iniated the activity check. This will show 'system' if it was an automated check.

params.name: responded-count
params.description: The number or staff members who responed to the activity check.

fields.name: Quick info overview
fields.value:
Ended at: %end-time%
Duration: %duration% hour(s)
Total responses: %responded-count%

content.name: sendingChannel
content.description: The default channel where the activity check message will be posted. This can manually be overridden with the command.

content.name: exceptionsType
content.description: Who are excused from the activity checks?

content.name: customExceptionRoles
content.description: Only applies if 'Custom role(s)' is selected above.

content.name: automatedChecks
content.description: If enabled, the bot will automatically start activity checks at configured intervals.

content.name: automatedCheckInterval
content.description: On which interval to start automatic checks. Choose cronjob for full customzation.

content.name: automatedCheckCronjob
content.description: The cronjob schedule for automatic checks. Only applies if 'Cronjob' is selected above.

content.name: automatedCheckWeekDay
content.description: The week day to start automatic checks.

content.name: automatedCheckMonthWeek
content.description: The week of the month to start automatic checks. Only applies if 'Monthly' is selected above.

content.name: logChannel
content.description: Where the final results are posted. Leave empty if you want to use the general log channel.

content.name: pingResults
content.description: Ping specific roles when the results are posted.

content.name: pingRoles
content.description: The roles to ping with the results message.
